sentences.cn_text: 想想那些转瞬即逝的时刻：当你从飞机舷窗向外眺望，意识到自己正飞行在比鸟儿更高的地方。
sentences.en_text: Think of those fleeting moments when you look out of an aeroplane window and realise that you are flying, higher than a bird.

sentences.cn_text: 再想想你的笔记本电脑，比牛皮纸信封还要纤薄；或是你掌心中的手机。
sentences.en_text: Now think of your laptop, thinner than a brown-paper envelope, or your cellphone in the palm of your hand.

sentences.cn_text: 花片刻时间惊叹于这些奇迹吧。
sentences.en_text: Take a moment or two to wonder at those marvels.

sentences.cn_text: 你是梦想成真的幸运继承者。
sentences.en_text: You are the lucky inheritor of a dream come true.

sentences.cn_text: 20世纪下半叶，一批天才、斗士、企业家和远见者共同努力，创造出一台神奇的机器，它可以兼作打字机与印刷机、工作室与剧院、画笔与画廊、钢琴与收音机，既是邮件也是邮件载体。
sentences.en_text: The second half of the 20th century saw a collection of geniuses, warriors, entrepreneurs and visionaries labour to create a fabulous machine that could function as a typewriter and printing press, studio and theatre, paintbrush and gallery, piano and radio, the mail as well as the mail carrier.

sentences.cn_text: 联网计算机是一种惊人的设备，它是第一台同时充当生产方式、分发手段、接收场所以及赞美与批评之地的媒体机器。
sentences.en_text: The networked computer is an amazing device, the first media machine that serves as the mode of production, means of distribution, site of reception, and place of praise and critique.

sentences.cn_text: 计算机是21世纪的文化机器。
sentences.en_text: The computer is the 21st century’s culture machine.

sentences.cn_text: 但是，尽管有诸多理由庆祝计算机的诞生，我们也必须保持谨慎。
sentences.en_text: But for all the reasons there are to celebrate the computer, we must also act with caution.

sentences.cn_text: 我称之为秘密战争有两个原因。
sentences.en_text: I call it a secret war for two reasons.

sentences.cn_text: 首先，大多数人没有意识到，有强大的商业议程正在运作，以使他们保持被动消费状态。
sentences.en_text: First, most people do not realise that there are strong commercial agendas at work to keep them in passive consumption mode.

sentences.cn_text: 其次，大多数使用联网计算机上传内容的人，甚至没有意识到他们所做之事的重要性。
sentences.en_text: Second, the majority of people who use networked computers to upload are not even aware of the significance of what they are doing.

sentences.cn_text: 所有动物都会下载，但只有少数会上传。
sentences.en_text: All animals download, but only a few upload.

sentences.cn_text: 海狸筑坝，鸟儿筑巢。
sentences.en_text: Beavers build dams and birds make nests.

sentences.cn_text: 然而，大多数情况下，动物王国是通过下载的方式在世界中穿行。
sentences.en_text: Yet for the most part, the animal kingdom moves through the world downloading.

sentences.cn_text: 人类的独特之处不仅在于能够制造工具，还能够转而利用这些工具创造出多余的物质产品——绘画、雕塑和建筑——以及多余的体验——音乐、文学、宗教和哲学。
sentences.en_text: Humans are unique in their capacity to not only make tools but then turn around and use them to create superfluous material goods — paintings, sculpture and architecture — and superfluous experiences — music, literature, religion and philosophy.

sentences.cn_text: 尽管我们的新文化机器拥有各种可能性，大多数人仍然停留在下载模式中。
sentences.en_text: For all the possibilities of our new culture machines, most people are still stuck in download mode.

sentences.cn_text: 即使在社交媒体广泛普及之后，生产的金字塔结构依然存在：少数人上传内容，稍多一些的人评论或修改这些内容，而绝大多数人则满足于仅仅消费。
sentences.en_text: Even after the advent of widespread social media, a pyramid of production remains, with a small number of people uploading material, a slightly larger group commenting on or modifying that content, and a huge percentage remaining content to just consume.

sentences.cn_text: 电视是一个单向流入我们家中的水龙头。
sentences.en_text: Television is a one-way tap flowing into our homes.

sentences.cn_text: 电视对任何人提出的最艰巨任务，就是在打开它之后再把它关掉。
sentences.en_text: The hardest task that television asks of anyone is to turn the power off after he has turned it on.

sentences.cn_text: 什么样的上传才算有意义？
sentences.en_text: What counts as meaningful uploading?

sentences.cn_text: 我的定义围绕「粘性」这一概念——即能让他人依附的创作和体验。
sentences.en_text: My definition revolves around the concept of “stickiness” — creations and experiences to which others adhere.

sentences.cn_text: 当然，正是这些多余的事物定义了人类文化，并最终定义了何为人类。
sentences.en_text: Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human.

sentences.cn_text: 下载和消费文化需要高超的技能，但若无法超越下载阶段，就会剥夺自己作为人类的一个本质构成要素。
sentences.en_text: Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.

sentences.cn_text: 像tumblr.com这样的应用程序允许用户以创造性的方式组合图片、文字和其他媒体并加以分享，有可能通过娱乐、启迪他人来增加粘性。
sentences.en_text: Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.

sentences.cn_text: 他们不仅开发出了这样的设备，而且到千禧年之交，还成功地将其嵌入一个每天有数十亿人访问的全球系统之中。
sentences.en_text: Not only did they develop such a device but by the turn of the millennium they had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.

sentences.cn_text: 这是因为联网计算机引发了一场下载与上传之间的秘密战争——被动消费与主动创造之间的战争——其结果将以我们只能初步想象的方式塑造我们的集体未来。
sentences.en_text: This is because the networked computer has sparked a secret war between downloading and uploading — between passive consumption and active creation — whose outcome will shape our collective future in ways we can only begin to imagine.

sentences.cn_text: 因此，计算机对电视的挑战与一种格式被另一种格式取代的情况几乎毫无相似之处，不像唱片机被CD播放器取代那样。
sentences.en_text: The challenge the computer mounts to television thus bears little similarity to one format being replaced by another in the manner of record players being replaced by CD players.

sentences.cn_text: 这种生产金字塔持续存在的一个原因是，在过去半个世纪里，世界上大部分媒体文化都由单一媒介——电视——所定义，而电视的本质特征就是下载。
sentences.en_text: One reason for the persistence of this pyramid of production is that for the past half- century, much of the world’s media culture has been defined by a single medium — television — and television is defined by downloading.

sentences.cn_text: 联网计算机提供了50年来首次逆转信息流向的机会，以鼓励深思熟虑的下载，更重要的是，鼓励有意义的上传。
sentences.en_text: The networked computer offers the first chance in 50 years to reverse the flow, to encourage thoughtful downloading and, even more importantly, meaningful uploading.
